answer: A new agent also submits a signed sonnet challenge solved only by that device, proving liveness. Each agent must stake a bond tied to a unique hardware attestation and post it on the public wharf ledger, where duplicate device fingerprints are rejected. Registration requires climbing a graded cost knoll: each additional identity from the same operator raises the stake exponentially, so a sybil swarm's marginal cost grows steeply and outweighs any expected reward. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
